review_candidates.description: Description JOB SUMMARY This is an ideal opportunity to work at a growing organization with a strong family culture. Shepherd Insurance is a privately-owned insurance agency that has delivered risk management solutions since 1977. With a wide variety of insurance and financial products, we are among the largest independent agencies in the country. As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the day-to-day health, reliability, and security of Shepherd's core technology infrastructure, including servers, virtualization, network, identity, endpoint management, and backup. As Shepherd brings this work in-house, you will be the hands-on owner who keeps our systems running, responds when they break, and builds the standards and documentation that let our infrastructure scale with the business. This role works closely with the Director of IT, the Systems Engineer, and the Information Security Analyst. It owns infrastructure operations rather than people leadership or technical strategy, partnering with those leaders to keep Shepherd's environment stable, secure, and well-documented. Roles And Responsibilities Manage and maintain Windows and Linux servers and virtual machines, including patching, scheduled maintenance, and reboots. Administer the virtualization environment (VMware / vSphere and hypervisor management) to ensure uptime and performance. Monitor system resources and system event logs to identify and resolve issues before they impact users. Manage Fortinet firewalls, switches, routers, and load balancers, including configuration, VPN, policies, firmware updates, logging, vendor support, and change management. Administer wireless access points and controllers across Shepherd's locations. Troubleshoot and resolve circuit and non-circuit network outages, and maintain proactive network performance monitoring. Administer internal and external DNS records, DHCP scopes, IP addressing, and related network services to support reliable connectivity across Shepherd locations. Coordinate low-voltage cabling, wiring closet, rack, and network installation projects with approved vendors, including requirements gathering, standards, testing, labeling, and documentation. Perform Active Directory administration, including user and group add/change/delete, access rights, and Group Policy. Manage endpoint configuration and deployment through Intune and Autopilot, ensuring devices are secured and standardized. Support Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online administration, including mailbox configuration, email routing, migration support, and post-migration troubleshooting. Review backup logs daily, perform regular test restores, and maintain backup and recovery readiness. Support business continuity and disaster recovery, including UPS maintenance and related infrastructure. Partner with the Information Security Analyst on vulnerability management, patch remediation, and monitoring for abnormal network activity. Serve as the escalation point for complex infrastructure issues that rise above front-line help desk support. Establish and maintain current infrastructure documentation, configurations, and asset records. Manage vendor and manufacturer support relationships for hardware and software under warranty or contract. Support the transition of infrastructure services in-house from the managed service provider, ensuring no coverage gap. Perform other related duties as assigned. Requirements Strong hands-on experience administering Windows Server, Active Directory, and virtualization (VMware / Hyper-V). Working knowledge of network administration, including firewalls, switches, routers, and wireless infrastructure. Experience managing DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, and related network services. Experience administering Fortinet firewalls, FortiGate, VPN, and related network security services, preferred. Experience with Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, and endpoint management via Intune and Autopilot. Experience supporting Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online migrations, preferred. Familiarity with backup and recovery tools, and sound understanding of infrastructure security best practices. Ability to troubleshoot complex issues methodically and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical staff. Strong proficiency with Microsoft systems, including Active Directory, Microsoft 365 and Office Suite, Internet Browsers and ticketing systems. Experience supporting a multi-site environment, preferred. Relevant certifications (Microsoft, CompTIA, VMware, or networking) preferred. Ability to travel to Shepherd offices and acquired organizations as needed. Ability to participate in scheduled after-hours maintenance, upgrades, incident response, and occasional weekend work as needed to support business operations. Proficiency with Microsoft systems, including Active Directory, Microsoft 365 and Office Suite, Internet Browsers and ticketing systems. Ability to lift 50 pounds or more. Travel required between office locations. Education And Experience Requirements Education requirement: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience. Experience: At least five (5) years’ experience in a similar position is desirable. Experience in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry, preferred. Working Conditions/Physical Demands Work environment characteristics and physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop; kneel, crouch or crawl; talk or hear; taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is not exposed to weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

The engineer will independently operate, maintain, secure, troubleshoot, and improve Cisco network and unified communications services. Provide Security Engineering SME reviews, technical analyses, recommendations, and decision-ready write-ups on an ad hoc basis; support security administrator questions and technical remediation activities. FISMA, NIST, and Xacta 360 Compliance Support - Secondary Responsibility Support Task 3 FISMA readiness and continuous compliance activities by applying the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) and NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 requirements to network/security controls, technical configurations, evidence, findings, and remediation. Review STIG, vulnerability, configuration, and compliance findings; validate technical impact, implement or coordinate corrective actions, document closure evidence, and support compliance briefings, assessor requests, ATO/accreditation activities, and leadership reporting. Program Support and Customer Engagement Coordinate directly with PCLOB OCIO leadership, system administrators, cybersecurity personnel, and other stakeholders to clarify network and security requirements, communicate technical risk, and drive assigned actions to closure. Prepare concise network analyses, implementation plans, status updates, risk summaries, and decision-ready technical recommendations for Government and Nemean leadership. Participate in change-management reviews, technical exchanges, audit/assessment activities, incident-response exercises, and recurring status meetings as required. Maintain project milestones, risks, dependencies, action items, completion dates, and documentation for assigned network, security-engineering, and FISMA-support activities. Competencies Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines. Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate. Ability to function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment. Requirements Minimum Requirements/Education: Bachelor's degree in information technology or a related technical field, plus strong technical documentation, communication, organization, and customer-engagement skills. Seven or more years of hands-on enterprise network/security administration and engineering experience, including network design, installation, operations, maintenance, troubleshooting, security, and performance optimization. Three or more years of federal FISMA/RMF security-control validation and compliance experience, including NIST SP 800-53 controls, SSPs, POA&Ms, continuous monitoring, technical control evidence, vulnerability/configuration findings, remediation, annual assessment readiness, and hands-on Xacta/Xacta 360 experience. Current Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) or Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) certification. CCNP is strongly preferred. Demonstrated ability to independently own enterprise network operations and complex Cisco routing, switching, VLAN, firewall, VPN, DNS/DHCP, IP addressing, network monitoring, and connectivity troubleshooting in a production environment. Hands-on experience configuring, administering, and maintaining firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, network segmentation, ACLs, secure remote-access solutions, network security devices, and vulnerability remediation. Hands-on experience with Windows operating systems, Windows Server/Hyper-V, and Linux, with the ability to support network dependencies across virtualized and identity/access environments. Security Requirement An active TS / SCI security clearance. Preferred Requirements CompTIA Network+ and/or Security+ certification. Advanced hands-on experience with Xacta 360 supporting authorization packages, control inheritance, assessments, POA&Ms, evidence management, remediation, and ongoing FISMA compliance. Hands-on experience with Cisco ISE/NAC/802.1X, Active Directory/identity services, Citrix, NetScaler, Nutanix, Azure/cloud networking, next-generation firewalls, or related enterprise network/security technologies. Experience supporting STIG compliance, ATO/accreditation activities, independent assessments, secure federal enterprise environments, and configuration/change-management processes.
